prerequisites: Use an appropriately vendor-patched cluster; conditional known fixes are tabulated below and in docs/compatibility-review.md.
Unsupported/post-baseline features require manual migration. PV topology labels require manual scheduling review; do not delete them to bypass the guard.
CSI drivers, attachment limits, mount/relabel/ID-mapped filesystem support and hardware/runtime profiles require operator validation.
Valid credentials, actual workload-SA SCC rights, working registry/mirrors/image trust and image-pull credentials are required.
HTTP and Endpoint UID checks do not prove UDP, external-gateway, secondary-network or every CNI traffic path; use application-specific checks.
Preflight is a point-in-time assessment; it reserves no quota/capacity and cannot guarantee later admission, image pull or startup.

assessment: ToleratesTaint now needs logger/feature argument; numeric comparison remains explicitly disabled. Eleven placement cases preserve Equal/Exists/default/wildcard/NoExecute policy.

Dynamic ConfigFor overrides explicitJSON when ambient CBOR flags are enabled. Reproduced nonJSONAccept and CBORbody; new per-client constructor reassertsJSON after upstream defaults and filters negotiation toJSON. Subprocess regression enables bothflags and checks dynamic reads/writes, typedSSAR, and rejection ofCBORresponses. No process-global feature state mutation.
Production discovery uses context-bounded exact/APIgroup-version REST paths, not removed aggregated v2beta1 discovery helpers. Generated clientset additions do not create requests until called.

No production informers/watchlist/cache APIs or removedTLS stop-channel API are called; pagination/readiness use existing explicit lists/polls. New unused generated types do not imply later server capabilities.
Client transport still uses normal kubeconfig loading/authentication; actual API errors and deadlines remain authoritative.
All postbaseline raw source/admission/resource fields continue to require manual review before typeddecode; SDK type knowledge does not widen automatic feature support.
